rules.statement: All flip-flops in the IP shall be scan-eligible, with no latch, combinational loop, tri-state, clock gating, or derived clock (REQ-DFT-001).
The SoC controls the scan clock and any reset override in its wrapper or reset controller; the IP has no DFT ports.
The IP is in the idle state after reset; test-mode entry/exit and safe state are handled by the SoC.
MBIST, memory repair, LBIST, test wrappers/test points, clock-gating test enable, extra ATPG constraints, and DFT insertion artifacts are not required in the IP beyond the general scan rule.
